_note: Research file for the CAPLE exams (ACESSO A1, CIPLE A2, DEPLE B1, DIPLE B2, DAPLE C1, DUPLE C2): the structure our own practice sets follow, checked by scripts/check-pruefungen.mjs (same modules, same parts, same number of scored items per part). Ids are storage keys and stay: goethe-a1…c2 = the six CAPLE certificates (goethe-a1 lives in the start-deutsch-1 slot, goethe-c2 has no practice set). Only structure is described; no CAPLE task or text is copied. items = scored items in OUR set; minutes = our practice timing; plays = how often a recording is heard in our set. Written from general knowledge on 2026-11-20 and NOT checked against caple.letras.ulisboa.pt: every official figure is 'to verify' (see `unverified` in each entry and reports/exams-caple.md).

exams.source: CAPLE (Centro de Avaliação de Português Língua Estrangeira, University of Lisbon), caple.letras.ulisboa.pt. Not checked against the current exam guide: everything about the official exam is 'to verify'.
